# exemplar polarity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarPolarity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The exemplar's direction. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): an exemplar that cannot say whether to emulate or avoid is just a citation.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md) -> [`gmeow:ExemplarPolarity`](../classes/gmeow-ExemplarPolarity.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md) from [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md) to [`gmeow:ExemplarPolarity`](../classes/gmeow-ExemplarPolarity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set an exemplar's single direction from the [`gmeow:ExemplarPolarity`](../classes/gmeow-ExemplarPolarity.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it or giving more than one (it is functional and mandatory — an exemplar without a direction is just a citation).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:exemplarPolarity`](gmeow-exemplarPolarity.md) once per [`gmeow:Exemplar`](../classes/gmeow-Exemplar.md); for cautionary exemplars add [`gmeow:exemplarRedirect`](gmeow-exemplarRedirect.md) to the criterion the passage actually evidences.
